articleTitle: Efficient ECG Signal Enhancement using Partial Update Augmented Complex LMS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: When an Electrocardiogram (ECG) is acquired by a sensor device in a clinical setting, it encounters many kinds of artefacts. These artefacts obscure the minute elements of the ECG signal’s PQRST complex, which are crucial for clinical monitoring and diagnosis. When the data signal in a practical biotelemetry-based sensing system is too lengthy, standard filters require a lot of iterations to process the samples. In this research, we present effective ECG signal improvement strategies that make use of Augmented Complex Least Mean Square Algorithm (ACLMS) to address this issue. By partial update processing of ECG signals, these techniques considerably minimize the computing burden on the filter and extract high-resolution, noise-free signals. In order to minimise the mean square error in comprehensive signal occurrence, the deepest descent technique is solved by the ACLMS algorithm. Compared to the traditional Least Mean Squared (LMS) based Adaptive Noise Canceler (ANC), this is demonstrated to be a steady state unbiased approach with less variance. Finally, we used these ANCs on the original ECG signals that were procured from the MIT-BIH open database, comparing their results to those of conventional LMS-based ANC. The findings indicate that when the signal length is abnormally long, the block implemented algorithms outperform their LMS counterparts with regard to Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR).

articleTitle: Engaging Investors through Social Media: A Positive Sentiment Analysis of Emtrade’s Twitter
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: This study analyzes the positive sentiment topics in Emtrade’s Twitter posts over one year. Emtrade, an EduFinTech company, uses its Twitter account to post information about the stock market. The research collected and analyzed 442 tweets from@emtrade_id, focusing on 65 positive sentiment tweets. Using sentiment analysis and the LDA algorithm, the study identified five main clusters of positive topics: financial performance, market potential, and investment opportunities, dividends and retail investor engagement, employment, and economic conditions, and market dynamics and commodity prices. The findings show that Emtrade’s tweets often discuss strong financial performance, market potential, and investment opportunities, which attract investors. Additionally, tweets about dividends and approachable investments are aimed at retail investors. The study provides insights into Emtrade’s communication strategy on social media, highlighting the company’s efforts to engage and attract investors through positive sentiment topics.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Prediction Models on the Tendency of Criminals to Recurrence of Criminal Activities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: To enhance internal state security, it is crucial to understand the reasons behind recidivism, as it is the criminal, not the public threat, who causes the crime. With the digitization of law enforcement information operations, integrating blockchain technology with machine learning techniques proves practical for predicting and preventing criminal activity. The application of ML algorithms for identifying key factors influencing recidivism among prisoners has been addressed in this article. Specifically, by examining various individual factors of convicts’, decision tree framework was employed to predict the likelihood of repeat infringements. The number of actual and suspended consecutive charges are the primary determinants of recidivism. Decision Tree models were developed to classify prisoners as either susceptible or not susceptible to reoffending, providing valuable insights for criminal justice decision-making and improving inmate management within the correctional system.

articleTitle: Comparative Cointegration of Stock Markets: Focus on NYSE, NSE And Shanghai Stock Exchange
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: This study investigates integration in the Indian stock market with a special focus on the National Stock Exchange (NSE). This study focuses on the connection between NSE, New York Stock Exchange (NYSE), and Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE). Understanding the interrelationships of international capital markets is important in determining different capital sources and developing international capital market policies. Given the strong momentum in the global economy, investors are looking for ways to achieve good results in the economy. This study uses EngleGranger and Johansen cointegration tests and a compilation of historical stock price measurements each month to determine the level of cointegration. Johansen’s correlation results confirm the long-term correlation between NSE Nifty, NYSE and SSE. Many of the findings highlight synergies between different sectors and provide insight to investors and policymakers.

articleTitle: Energy Management Strategy for a DC Micro-Grid system using FOPID Controller and POA Optimization Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: This paper introduces a unique Energy management scheme (EMS) designed to improve the distribution of energy among photovoltaic (PV) systems, fuel cells (FC), and battery energy storage systems. The suggested approach seeks to close the gap between consumption and generation while simultaneously managing the voltage level of the DC bus. A newly developed Pufferfish Optimization Algorithm (POA) has been employed for optimizing the FOPID controller. The performance of the suggested EMS is assessed through simulations that regulate DC bus voltages under varying solar irradiation and load demand conditions.

articleTitle: Real Time Identification of Students’ Stress Factors using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Students’ stress is a significant concern impacting academic performance and well-being of students across the globe. By leveraging machine learning techniques, this research aims to develop a robust model capable of accurately identifying stress factors amongst students. For this research, the initial dataset was taken from Kaggle. However, to enhance the dataset’s diversity and relevance, additional samples were collected directly from students and combined with the original dataset. In this work, different machine learning models have been used for comprehensive stress detection which were evaluated using different performance metrics. Further, a novel interactive interface was developed to provide students with a real time, personalized stress detection experience. The system also provides recommendations based on the detected stress level. This research not only enriches the dataset but also provides machine learning enabled interface to tackle the concern of the students.

articleTitle: A Secure and Collaborative Approach to Breast Tumor Detection Using Federated Learning and CNNs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Breast cancer is a major health problem affecting many women worldwide, causing a multitude of deaths, and benefits from early identification for successful treatment. In this study, an original federated learning system combined with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) is outlined to solve the challenge of data privacy in joint medical research concerning inter-institutional breast tumour recognition. Obtaining an accuracy of 95.4%, a precision of 94.8%, a recall of 96.1%, and an F1-score of 95.4%, the federated model outperformed the baseline centralized model's accuracy of 94.7%. This proposed system makes it possible for a wide variety of institutions to partner on the training of a global model that keeps patient data secure, thus noticeably lessening privacy issues and ensuring conformity with standards such as GDPR and HIPAA. The federated model demonstrated its efficacy by dealing with data heterogeneity, ensuring higher performance across datasets from diverse institutions reflecting varying picture quality and demographics. The ROC Area Under the Curve (AUC) of the federated model was 0.97 in opposition to 0.95 for the centralized model, demonstrating better discriminatory precision. This study draws attention to the opportunities for federated learning in health applications, which require strict data privacy, as well as a wide array of accurate, high-quality datasets to foster effective diagnostic models. The next initiatives will seek to improve communication efficiency and investigate fresh CNN designs to boost performance. This study presents a privacy-preserving method that can be scaled up for breast tumour identification, which in turn promotes enhanced multi-institutional relationships within healthcare.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Sign Interpretation: Merging VGG16 and ResNet50 for Superior Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Sign language recognition (SLR) is important for helping people who are deaf or hard of hearing communicate with others. This work studies how two popular deep learning models, VGG16 and ResNet50, are used for tasks connected to SLR. We used the VGG16 and ResNet50 models, and we got very high accuracy rates of 99.92% and 9995% in correctly recognizing sign language gestures. Our research shows that these models work well at accurately recognizing hand movements and gestures, which helps people who use sign language communicate more easily. Our research uses advanced computer methods to help make SLR systems better. This offers great chances for better communication and making things easier for everyone.

articleTitle: The Use of Activity Models and Regression Analysis for Development Effort Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Majority of modern-day industries operate with the help of computer applications which contain hardware and software parts. Software programs are extremely important and developing them can be quite challenging. Creation of high-calibre software, early prediction of work-effort is of paramount significance. This study attends to this requirement for modern-day applications. The process followed in this study extracts the features existing in the UML(Unified Modeling Language) Activity-models made for the systems. These features collaborated with custom-made Machine Learning Regression Analysis (ML-RA) programs were utilized for early prediction of work-effort. The ML-RA programs employed were: Bayesian-Ridge-Regression (BRR), Artificial-Neural-Network (ANN), K-Nearest-Neighbor (KNN), Extreme-Gradient-Boosting (EGB) and Extreme-Learning-Machines (ELM). Based on the outcomes of our experiments, it was clear that the ELM approach provided the highest accuracy with respect to other ML models.

articleTitle: IFLNLP: An Improved Federated Learning and Natural Language Processing-based Smart Healthcare System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: The healthcare industry has automated due to artificial intelligence (AI). The smart healthcare system has been greatly improved by current developments and significant capabilities of machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), and natural language processing (NLP). Still, there are certain challenges left that need to be addressed. The research of privacy-preserving, decentralized learning strategies is necessary for NLP and ML problems because of increasing rules and regulations. Federated learning (FL) provides straightforward methods for multiple clients to work together to train a single global model that meets the objectives of all clients while protecting local data, offering continuous training, and building a useful platform to handle heterogeneous input from various models. The proposed study presents a novel Improved-FLNLP (IFLNLP) and analyzes NLP workflow for smart healthcare with a special focus on FL. IFLNLP is an analytical framework for FL and NLP based smart healthcare systems. The experimental results obtained prove that the proposed approach, IFLNLP, yields the highest level of data privacy $\mathbf{(9 8 \%}$) and cost effectiveness $(\mathbf{9 5 \%})$, showing its strong privacy protection skills and better cost effectiveness as compared to NLP and FL. It maintains the same accuracy rate with the FL-based system and comparatively better accuracy than the NLP-based system.

articleTitle: Enhancing Soil Moisture Forecasting with Ensemble Learning: An Approach towards Sustainable Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Irrigation plays a pivotal role in agriculture, yet inefficient techniques often result in significant water wastage. An effective approach is needed to meet the increasing demands of global economies through improved resource management. Additionally, precise soil moisture (SM) forecasting is essential for making well-informed agricultural decisions and enabling efficient water use. In the era of evolving sustainable agriculture, digital tools and real-time data analysis can be a solution to this problem. This study addresses the challenge by developing an adaptive SM prediction model, aimed at optimizing irrigation practices. Utilizing ensemble learning algorithms, this research integrates an internet of things (IoT) database for SM prediction. The findings indicate that a Catboost based stacked ensemble regressor demonstrates promising performance in forecasting SM both for small and large datasets. The model is shown to be beneficial for enhancing agricultural output, promoting water conservation and supporting adaptable irrigation systems.

Author Keywords: adaptive data driven irrigation management system

articleTitle: AI-Driven System for Real-Time Transformation of Web Applications into Mobile-Friendly Versions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: In this paper, I present a novel approach for dynamically transforming Hyper Text Markup Language (HTML) content to create mobile-friendly web pages using generative AI. Traditional methods for responsive web design rely on pre-defined Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) frameworks and media queries to adjust the layout and appearance of web content for different devices. These methods often require significant manual effort and do not always accommodate the dynamic and complex nature of modern web applications, particularly those with interactive elements. My approach leverages a fine-tuned Generative Pre-trained Transformer 2 (GPT-2) model to intelligently adapt and transform HTML content, including complex elements like dropdowns, forms, and other interactive components, to enhance usability on mobile devices. By automating the transformation process, this method reduces the need for extensive manual intervention, providing a scalable and efficient solution for maintaining responsive web applications. I offer a thorough explanation of the process, outlining the specific stages of data preparation, model training, and deployment. Through experiments and results, I demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach in various scenarios, showcasing significant improvements in user experience and interaction on mobile devices. This paper contributes to the field of web development by introducing an AI-driven solution that addresses the limitations of traditional responsive design techniques, paving the way for more adaptive and intelligent web content transformation.

articleTitle: Innovative Machine Learning Approaches to Cardiovascular Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) are a principal factor in health issues and death throughout the world, introducing extensive challenges to healthcare systems and impacting countless lives. This paper explores the application of various machine learning models to predict and monitor CVDs, leveraging data from wearable sensors and smart health devices. We analysed models featuring Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machines (SVM), Decision Trees, Random Forests, Gradient Boosting, KNearest Neighbors, and Voting Classifiers. Our in-depth examination revealed that most models achieved remarkable accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-scores with the Voting Classifier. These models’ high accuracy and straightforward implementation make them suitable for real-world clinical settings, where computational resources may be limited. By enabling early detection and continuous monitoring, these machine learning approaches can personalize healthcare, improve patient outcomes, and reduce healthcare costs. The integration of these advanced technologies promises to enhance cardiovascular disease management, providing timely interventions and better health monitoring, ultimately contributing to reduced incidence and severity of CVDs.

articleTitle: Comparative Assessment of ML Models for Water Quality Prediction in Biofloc Aquaculture: A Data-Driven Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: During the cutting edge technology of Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL), plays a vital role for finding the best approach for data pre-processing, model selection, training and testing, prediction and analysis, result analysis, accuracy of predictions. Using the methodologies of ML models the real-time monitoring of biofloc model can be achieved through which the water quality can be predicted. Different researches have been carried out with multiple ML models on biofloc water quality dataset but through this article the genuine dataset provided by central government is experimented with ML and DL. Finally with different parameters the models have been tested and results have been displayed.

articleTitle: Content-Based Radar Image Retrieval Using CNN Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: This study introduces a technique, for content based image retrieval (CBIR) specifically designed for radar image datasets, which are known for their complexity and high dimensionality. Achieving an precision (mAP) of 93.6% and an impressive retrieval accuracy of 94.8% the proposed system leverages advanced machine learning methods to enhance retrieval precision and efficiency. Additionally the system demonstrates a 35% reduction in retrieval time compared to state of the art approaches. A comprehensive evaluation was conducted, encompassing performance metrics, confusion matrices and detailed tabular analysis to validate these findings. For applications requiring accurate image retrieval these studies underscore the systems ability to handle radar image datasets with increased precision and speed thereby substantiating its effectiveness. The robustness and efficacy of the proposed method indicate its potential for application across disciplines where radar imaging is essential.

articleTitle: Design of PV fed Bidirectional Converter using PI Controller for EV Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Now a days the charging of electric vehicles (EV) is tough task in using the renewable resources. PV system is the better solution regarding this matter. This paper reflects, the charging of EV battery from the PV system using the control mechanism. Bidirectional DC-DC converter is deployed here to transform the power flow from solar system to EV battery system for the purpose of both charging and discharging of battery. The converter output is regulated by using PI controller and the operation of the bidirectional converter is running in both buck and boost mode by reversing the direction of power flow. The battery storage system is used to store the voltage while the weather conditions vary. Simulink results are shown and verified in MATLAB/Simulink platform.

articleTitle: Computer Vision Techniques for Automated Detection of Wildflower Growth Stages
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: This paper presents a new methodology that utilizes computer vision techniques for the automatic detection and classification of stages in wildflower growth. Wild plant development monitoring is essential for ecological studies and biodiversity preservation as well as for environmental management. The approach makes use of novel state-of-the-art computer vision algorithms for the processing of high-resolution images of wildflowers against diverse background scenes. A labeled dataset of wildflower species, at various growth stages, will aid in supervised learning. The system identifies and accurately classifies the growth stage using CNNs and image segmentation algorithms to perform feature extraction. This paper works under computer vision in ecology, thereby simplifying the monitoring of the development processes of wild plant growth while conserving biodiversity.

articleTitle: Bibliometric Evaluation of Green Technology and Green Finance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Sustainability is the word that is gravitating in today’s world. But with technological breakthroughs, the question arises “Can sustainability and technology, gel together while promoting sustainable alternatives?” When we talk about green technology, we accentuate the application of engineering approaches used to develop products and services with a vision to save the environment. This study aims to dig deep into the existing literature on this area of interest and gain insights regarding the current situation, which can lead to better advancements and developments in future studies that other scholars will carry out. The study has undergone rigorous analysis encompassing bibliometric evaluation using parameters like citation analysis, co-occurrence analysis, co-citation analysis and bibliographic coupling. The Scopus database and VOS viewer software were used for analysing the results.

articleTitle: Design, Analysis and Implementation of an Electric Bicycle With GPS
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: In the recent times, the number of vehicles on the road has been rapidly increasing, which promotes the air pollution levels ultimately contributing to global warming. A green mode of transportation in cities made possible with the advent of Electric bicycles, or e-bikes, which are getting popularity. The power from the pedal can be recovered as well as the energy from regenerative braking to maximise the efficiency and sustainability. Installing an electrical bicycle with a BLDC motor and utilizing a GPS tracking system are the two components of this project.

articleTitle: Innovative Variable Structure PWM Method with the Nearest-Level Modulation Technique in a Five-Level Multilevel Inverter
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Multilevel inverters are widely used in high-power applications due to their ability to generate high-quality waveforms with reduced harmonic content and electromagnetic interference. This paper presents a novel variable structure pulse width modulation (PWM) technique for a five-level H-bridge multilevel inverter. The proposed PWM technique utilizes the nearest-level modulation (NLM) principle to reduce the computational burden and improve the efficiency of the inverter. The implementation of the proposed PWM technique on a five-level H-bridge multilevel inverter is described, and experimental results are presented to evaluate its performance.

articleTitle: Optimized stacked classifier to predict Hepatitis B disease
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Ensemble machine learning approaches are being used for classifying many tasks like sentiment analysis, stock price prediction, breast cancer prediction etc. Stacked classifier is a type of ensemble learning which used multiple classifiers for generating best classification. The paper presents optimized stacked classifier to predict Hepatitis B disease. Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique. (SMOTE) is used to handle class imbalance issue in the dataset. To optimize the parameters of Meta classifier grid search technique is used. The performance of stacked classifier is compared with performance of random forest, gradient boost and support vector machine classifier. Results show that the best accuracy is presented by stacked classifier which is 90% as compare to the accuracy presented by random forest, support vector machine and gradient boost algorithm.

articleTitle: Enhanced Textual Image Classification with Ensemble Learning of MobileNetV2 and ResNet50
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Textual image classification is crucial in various applications, such as document digitization and automatic language identification. Although ensemble learning has been increasingly utilized to improve the accuracy of deep learning models, the optimal approaches for this task are still under-explored. This research evaluates the effectiveness of ensemble learning techniques for textual image classification, focusing on combining Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) like MobileNetV2 and ResNet50. The dataset used in this study includes images in multiple languages, adding complexity to the classification task. By leveraging ensemble learning, we enhanced the performance of these models, achieving an accuracy of 77%, surpassing the individual CNN models. These findings suggest that ensemble learning can significantly boost the effectiveness of deep learning models in textual image classification tasks.

articleTitle: Safe Distance Maintaining Car To Avoid Accident
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: This article contributes to enhancing safety in the automotive industry by focusing on maintaining safe distances between vehicles and promptly detecting accidents. It utilizes an Accelerometer to identify deviations in x, y, and z parameters, recording accidents when predefined thresholds are exceeded. The Global System for Mobile Communication module enables communication between the microcontroller system and the user through Short Message Service, promptly identifying accident scenes. The Arduino microcontroller regulates the system, programmed in embedded C language for efficiency. Experimental results confirm successful integration of Arduino with GPS and GSM modules, facilitating effective system control and communication with emergency services. Accelerometer sensors trigger alerts via SMS to the rescue team, ensuring swift response and timely medical assistance, thereby enhancing road safety, and saving lives.

articleTitle: Minimization of Control Error and Frequency variation in Two Area based Load Frequency Control using GA Tuned Fractional PIλDμ Controller by Reducing Integral Absolute based Error
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: In order to provide adequate, dependable, highquality electric power, one of the most important aspects of power system management and control is automatic generation control, sometimes referred to as load frequency control. A generator’s output power is adjusted by the feedback control system AGC to maintain a defined frequency. Control schemes are necessary for efficient and economical handling of all aspects of power dynamics. Since current LFC system parameters are frequently adjusted using trial-and-error methods, traditional approaches, and experiences, they are unable to deliver sufficient dynamic performance across a wide range of operating situations and load scenarios. In the present work, the influence of performance indice Integral Absolute error is mitigated by employing Genetic Optimization tuned controllers to evaluate and exhibit the response for a Two area system with variations in load and frequency. PID controllers and PID controllers with fractional orders is utilized to migitate the error. A comparison between the two tuned controllers and the simulation results is shown.

Author Keywords: Two Area based Load Frequency Control

articleTitle: Marathi Text to ISL Gloss Translation Using LSTM, GRU and Transformer Neural Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: In the Deaf and hard-of-hearing groups, sign languages are crucial for efficient communication. However, there is a significant language barrier between sign languages and spoken/written languages. The challenging work of translating written information into glosses in sign language is essential to improving communication for these people. In the context of text-to-sign language gloss translation, this article compares three neural architectures: Gated Recurrent Units (GRU), Attention-based Neural Machine Translation (NMT), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). A custom dataset that includes paired text and sign gloss sequences is used to assess the models, with an emphasis on accuracy, fluency, and contextual relevance.

articleTitle: Enhanced Facial Emotion Recognition Using Transfer Learning with ResNet152
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: The prospective applications of facial expression-based emotion recognition have sparked a lot of interest in domains like camera technology, mental health analysis, and human-computer interaction. Using the ResNet152 architecture, we suggest a unique facial emotion recognition (FER) technique that makes use of preprocessing, data augmentation, and transfer learning. While deep learning techniques, particularly when combined with CNNs, are known to be successful for classification problems, conventional methods have difficulty optimizing both feature extraction and classification at the same time. Through extensive testing on a dataset, the research shows that the suggested method is effective, with ResNet152 obtaining an accuracy of $\mathbf{8 4 \%}$. Experiments on randomly selected photos from different sources revealed encouraging outcomes for precise and instantaneous FER. This study presents a strong method for FER that makes use of transfer learning and deep learning, providing notable improvements over traditional methods.

articleTitle: Mastering Multi-Class Bone Marrow Classification with EfficientNetB5: Challenges and Innovations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Classifying bone marrow pictures into different categories is challenging due to issues like uneven numbers of examples in each category, differences within the same category, and the need for very accurate and easy-to-understand diagnostic models. These challenges make it hard to create reliable automated systems for medical diagnosis. To find different blood diseases, it’s important to correctly identify images of bone marrow. There are some challenges in multi-class classification, like the need for clear and correct results, differences in shapes, and uneven numbers of classes. This work looks at using a modern type of computer model called EfficientNetB5 to help sort images of bone marrow. Our method reaches a high accuracy of 96% by using special loss functions, new ways to increase data variety, and tools to understand the results. Using the strong design of EfficientNetB5, our method reaches an impressive 96% accuracy in classifying items, which is a big improvement.

articleTitle: Detection and Localization of Car Damages Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: In the automotive industry, accurate and efficient vehicle damage detection is crucial for reducing the cost of claims and improving assessment procedures. This paper presents an automated method for vehicle damage detection using deep learning based You Only Look Once models, specifically YOLOv3, YOLOv5, and YOLOv8, in conjunction with two optimizers, AdamW and SGD. The COCOtoYOLO dataset contains pictures with six damage kinds. Gaussian Blur, Median Blur, Grayscale conversion, and Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) improved picture quality and feature visibility. The results reveal that YOLOv8, optimized with SGD over 200 epochs, achieved the highest mean Average Precision (mAP-50) of $72 \%$, surpassing other configurations. This study demonstrates the effectiveness of YOLOv8 and SGD in vehicle damage detection. The highest F1-score of ${9 3 \%}$ for glass shutter class claims the model’s robustness for different types of car damages.

articleTitle: Reimagining Disease Detection in Cassava Leaves with Advanced AI Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: In the Philippines, there are many diseases that seriously harm the growth and production of cassava, which is the most important crop. Since people rely on cassava for food, it’s very important to find and deal with diseases early before they get worse. The methods used for finding diseases rely on the expert knowledge of related products and the experience of the people involved. This work presents an automatic system that uses existing models of neural networks and deep learning, based on methods from convolutional neural networks, to manage unclear data for recognizing diseases. In this study, we used a model called EfficientnetB3 to identify diseases in cassava plants with unclear data. The model had 10,791,220 parameters that could be adjusted during training, and we used a method called transfer learning to help with this process. Our method for finding crop diseases can help automatically collect information to identify diseases and stop crop loss.

articleTitle: Perspectives on Fintech Adoption in Developing Economies from Indian User Behaviour
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Fintech confronts traditional models to produce a viable way to address the persistent global issue of financial inclusion. The study elucidates how fundamental factors social, influence, perceived ease of use (PEOU), usefulness (PU) and resource availability (RA) act to determine use behaviour by concentrating on important variables. Results indicate that 24.5 percent consistency in users’ intentions to actual usage for Digital Fintech Services (DFS), while 11.5 percentage of user’s consistency ensued predicted usage of Fintech that manifests substantial explanatory power. According to key findings, behavioural intention is significantly predicted by performance expectancy and social influence being primarily driven by perceptions of enhancing societal status.

Author Keywords: Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT)

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Residual Life Assessment for Health Indexing of Distribution Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Distribution Transformers, as defined by the Bureau of Indian Standards, cover relatively smaller transformers with capacity up to 2500 kVA and a maximum voltage rating of 33 kV (phase-phase) in the primary & supplying at 415 V to the end consumers. Since these transformers serve as a direct connection between the Distribution Company (DISCOM) & the consumers, ensuring reliability of operation of these transformers is critical to the customer satisfaction, revenue optimization & branding. However, the huge & scattered population of these assets with relatively lesser per unit cost, makes the conventional maintenance of these assets cost & manpower intensive. In a regulated framework, the need of the hour is cost optimization while ensuring maximum system reliability. Rising unpredictability in climatic conditions have added to the challenges of utilities, as the utilities are seeing a surge in peak demand exceeding their generous forecasts, making it difficult to plan CAPEX investments. The paper focuses on the use of Machine Learning Algorithms for devising a technique to assess the current health of the Distribution transformers by predicting their residual life, thereby, helping utilities in making informed decisions over maintenance, repair, refurbishment, investment, quality assessment, and control.

articleTitle: Efficient Protocols for the Secure Transmission of Training Parameters in a Federated Network: Research Frontiers, Taxonomy, and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Federated Learning (FL), which ensures data privacy while jointly increasing model accuracy, has emerged as a viable method for collaborative machine learning across decentralized and heterogeneous data sources. However, because of differing computational capacities and security requirements, securely communicating training parameters across heterogeneous participants continues to be a significant difficulty. The present study offers an extensive overview of the state of research in the field and employs a taxonomy based on cryptography techniques, including Differential Privacy (DP), Homomorphic Encryption (HE), Secure Multiparty Computation (SMPC), and Blockchain technology, to classify the current secure transmission protocols. Additionally, it suggests future lines of inquiry for optimization and hybrid approaches to improve security, scalability, and efficiency in heterogeneous federated networks. For scholars and practitioners looking to propel the field of FL into more robust and privacy-preserving collaborative learning settings, the insights and taxonomy offered provide a road map

articleTitle: Enhancing performance appraisal in CBSE Schools through HR Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: In the evolving educational landscape, effective performance appraisal systems are critical for ensuring the quality of teaching and overall institutional success. This abstract provides an overview of how HR analytics can transform performance appraisals for CBSE school teachers, highlighting the potential benefits and future research opportunities. It’s an effort to integrate HR analytics into the performance appraisal process for teachers in CBSE (Central Board of Secondary Education) schools. The study explores the application of HR analytics to gather and analyze various performance metrics, including teaching effectiveness, student feedback, and professional development activities. By employing statistical and machine learning techniques, the research identifies key performance indicators (KPIs) that are predictive of teaching excellence and student outcomes. The findings suggest that HR analytics can significantly enhance the appraisal process by providing a comprehensive view of teacher performance. This approach not only offers a more objective basis for evaluations but also aids in identifying areas for professional growth and development.

articleTitle: Partial Shading Effect Minimization in a PV Array using Shading Behaviour based Adaptive Reconfiguration Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: During the partial shading in a PV array, the modules of the same array receive a different level of irradiance, this phenomenon is known as the partial shading. Partial shading deeply effects the maximum available power of PVs, moreover, this results in the multiple maximums on the power versus voltage curves. The partial shading on PV array can be dispersed by physically relocating or rearranging the arrays of the modules. In this paper, the partial shading pattern incident on the PV array is investigated to develop the physical reconfiguration algorithm for PV modules. In this algorithm, the irradiance value of each module is compared to locate the partially shaded modules, further these modules are arranged in one column to increase the power output. The shading behaviour based adaptive reconfiguration algorithm (SBARA) is applied on a $3 \times 3$ array configuration and is tested for three different case scenarios. Three different partial shading patterns are simulated on the array using the MATLAB software, SBARA is called in each case to reconfigure the modules, the results are obtained by analyzing the power vs voltage curve of PV array.

articleTitle: Traffic Flow Prediction Using LSTM, ARIMA & SARIMA Model for Intelligent Transportation System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Accurate and timely prediction of traffic data is an essential component in the planning, administration, and control of urban traffic in Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS). Our study is dedicated to exploring three distinct models: LSTM (Long Short Term Memory), ARIMA (Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average) with parameters ($p, d, q$) that specify autoregression, differencing, and moving average orders, and SARIMA (Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average), intended for analyzing seasonal time series data. ARIMA and SARIMA models are conventional statistical techniques employed for the study of time series data. They provide reliable methodologies for forecasting future traffic patterns through the analysis of historical data. To choose the most efficient model among the three options, we utilize performance measurement procedures to evaluate their predictive abilities. We utilize an external dataset obtained from the U.S. Government Open Repository. This dataset is classified as geographical data. Upon analysis, it was shown that all three SARIMA models had superior performance.

articleTitle: Automated System For Efficient Cervical Cancer Screening Using Cervicogram Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Cervicography, a diagnostic technique that checks and identifies problems in the cervix area with its major aim being cervical cancer, is used. This involves application of 5% acetic acid to the cervix followed by capturing detailed images of it through special imaging technology. The proposed method offers an alternative to conventional ones such as Pap smears that are both time-consuming and call for well trained staff. Cervicography is widely used in community screening programmes due to its ability to be completed quickly and efficiently on a larger number of women. Furthermore, it has improved sensitivity for detecting abnormalities in the cervical canal thus providing clearer pictures of the cervix while also increasing possibilities for finding premalignant or malignant growths. The purpose of this study is to use cervicogram images for improvement of the cervical cancer screening techniques. This study proposes a Dirichlet Ensemble Model with RoI extraction of cervix using You Only Look Once (YOLO) framework. The classification model uses Kaggle Intel and MobileODT dataset for training, validation and testing. The testing accuracy obtained as 80%, F1 score of 0.79 and ROC AUC score as 0.8327.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of PSO and GWO Algorithms in Fractional-Order Low Pass Filter Design
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: This work, in an effort to improve the functionality and adaptability of electronic filters, is exploring the design of a Fractional Order Lowpass Filter by means of evolving algorithms. Filters’ fractional order transfer functions provide a more fluid representation of system dynamics than traditional integer order filter. Evolutionary algorithms are employed in the design phase to enhance the fractional-order filter’s parameters. Among the frequency response parameters that are optimized for are cut-off frequency, roll-off, and attenuation. Evolutionary algorithms are a useful tool for efficiently solving the difficult parameter space problems of fractional-order filters by swiftly identifying the optimal solutions. Through the examination of various filter configurations made possible by the algorithmic framework, designs that balance filter complexity and performance are found.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Low-cost Remote Monitoring Scheme for Power and Distribution Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: This project is about design and implementation of a system to monitor and record key parameters of a powerand distribution transformer like oil level, temperature of top and bottom oil of transformers, ambient temperature, tap changing operation count etc. The system of on-line monitoring system integrates IoT sensors with EDGE computing capacity, fitted in the different parts of the transformers with a global service mobile (GSM) gateway. It is installed at the transformer site and the values of these parameters are sent to a database server residing in CESC’s premises. A web application has been developed in-house, which shows these parameters and variation of the same over time. Apart from that it not only captures the instantaneous data but also stores the data for thirty days in the server so that if any history, regarding the performance of the assets are required then the data can be easily fetched offfrom the server. Most important feature of it is thatduring healthy condition the instantaneous values recorded will be displayed in green colour at the softwareand if any of the monitored parameters, exceed or go below the preset threshold value then the color, displayed in green for that parameter will automatically change to red color. Along with that an alarm in the formof SMS and mail will be sent to the registered user, who can then take necessary actions and resolve the problemover there.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning-Based Approach to Improve Fraud Detection using ISSO and PKRR
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Fraud detection has become increasingly crucial in various industries, particularly within financial sectors. This study introduces a novel machine learning framework that integrates ISSO with PKRR to enhance fraud detection capabilities. By combining ISSO’s optimization strengths with PKRR’s robust regression and partitioning capabilities, the proposed model significantly boosts detection rates and minimizes false positives. This integrated approach addresses existing limitations, offering a scalable, adaptive, and effective solution for safeguarding financial systems against evolving fraud threats. Preliminary results indicate that this framework outperforms traditional methods, highlighting its potential for widespread application in the financial industry.

articleTitle: Implementation of YOLOv9 in Agricultural AI for Enhanced Weed Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Weeds significantly hinder agricultural productivity by reducing crop yields and increasing production costs. Leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) is critical for equipping farmers with early detection capabilities to implement effective weed management strategies. Among AI technologies, deep learning (DL) techniques are especially effective for analyzing agricultural field images to identify weed species. This paper reviews state-of-the-art DL methodologies, with a focus on the YOLOv9 model for weed detection. Our findings highlight YOLOv9’s superior effectiveness, achieving an accuracy of $\mathbf{9 0 \%}$, due to its robust architecture and advanced feature extraction. The model’s proficiency in accurately identifying weeds is evident from our thematic analysis. We also explore various image acquisition devices, including robots, drones, and mobile phones. Comparative evaluations show that YOLOv9 consistently outperforms other DL techniques, achieving remarkable accuracy and speed. This study includes a comparative analysis of several algorithms like SSD, Mask R-CNN, and Fast R-CNN, underscoring YOLOv9’s superior performance. This paper serves as a valuable resource for researchers and practitioners, guiding future efforts in weed management and precision agriculture by emphasizing YOLOv9’s transformative potential.

articleTitle: Alzheimer’s Disease Prediction from MRI image using Convolutional Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Alzheimer’s disease is one sort of neurological disorder which affects the daily activities and it is incurable. But, if it can be detected early, then it may be prevented or made to progress slowly. For detection, deep learning has played a great role now a days. In this paper, we have taken 6400 MRI images of both dementia and non-dementia subjects. The dataset is spilt into ${8 0 \%}$ for training a model and ${2 0 \%}$ for validating and accessing the achievement of the trained model. We have recommended a two-dimensional convolutional neural network architecture in order to apply on the MRI dataset to generate a model for classifying and predicting Alzheimer’s disease patients. The model generated using the proposed two-dimensional architecture has given approximately $98 \%$ classification accuracy. Besides, we have presented roc-auc curve, f1-score, recall, support, precision and confusion matrix to show the execution of the model. Again, at training procedure, model loss and accuracy also depicted according to epoch times. The researches already performed on prediction of Alzheimer’s disease has given poor performance of ${9 1 \%}$ classification accuracy in comparison to our model.

articleTitle: Enhancement of various images using coefficients of Analytic Functions with PythonTM
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: This paper presents a new method for image enhancement using a sub-class of analytic functions. The method uses mathematical functions to process pixel values, enhancing visual properties such as contrast, sharpness, and brightness. Using these functions, the method improves, preserves details, and increases clarity in this conventional method. The system is versatile, adapting to a wide range of models including medical, satellite, and biological. The test results show a significant improvement in image quality, which has been verified by metering rates and visual inspection. This approach provides a robust and efficient solution for applications that require high-quality imaging and opens the way for advances in imaging technology.

articleTitle: Software Product Effort Estimation with Sequence Diagrams and Regression Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Software development effort prediction is a critical aspect of project management. In order to successfully complete a product within all the constraints, the forecasted effort must be fairly reliable. In this work, we have come up with a reasonably viable work-effort estimation for projects developed through Object Oriented Analysis and Design (OOAD) Approach. The approach proposed in this work uses a selected set of features present in the Unified Modeling Language (UML) Sequence diagrams and customized ‘Machine-Learning Regression-analysis (ML-RA)’ programs to come up with a viably accurate prediction. The ML techniques include: Extreme Gradient Boosting (EGB), Extreme Learning Machines (ELM), Decision Tree (DT), Bayesian Ridge Regression (BRR) and Gaussian Processes with Neural Network Kernels methods (GPNN). Based on the out-comes of our experiments, it was clearly evident that the GPNN approach provided the highest accuracy with respect to other ML models.

articleTitle: Region of Operation Based Flexible Power Point Tracking Algorithm for PV Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: During the maximum power point tracking (MPPT) operation of photovoltaics (PV), the operating point is locked at the maximum and there is no margin for active power reserve. This operation restrains the photovoltaics from participating in ancillary services. Thus, the flexible power point tracking (FPPT) operation is becoming more popular amongst PV researchers as this operates the PVs below the maximum power point (MPP). However, in FPPT, there is an ambiguity relating to the operation on right or left hand side of the MPP on the power versus voltage ($\mathrm{P}-\mathrm{V}$) curve, thus, in this paper, a region of operation based flexible power point tracking (ROPFPPT) algorithm is proposed which is capable of operating in both the regions. The command of region of operation is taken as input from the operator. The algorithm is implemented on a simple single stage configuration of PV system and is tested for two simulation scenarios, in the first scenario, flexible power point (FPP) power value is increased and the same is decreased in the second scenario. The ROP-FPPT is operated in both the regions for these simulation scenarios to analyze the optimal region of operation. The simulations of the developed model are carried out in the MATLAB software.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Technique Based Plant Disease Detection And Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Today, agricultural production drives the economy. Agriculture has numerous facets, and plant disease diagnosis is one of the most important. Plant diseases are very common. Disease detection prevents yield and quantity losses. Plant diseases are studied through studying plant patterns. Environmentally friendly farming requires monitoring plant health and leaf diseases. Traditional methods have detected plant leaf diseases for decades. Several research studies have shown that effective methods for plant disease identification are still needed. Thus, deep learning and image processing architectures recognize plant leaf diseases. Image Acquisition, Pre-Processing, Segmentation, Feature Extraction, and Classification comprise this illness detection method. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) are also used on input datasets. This method simplifies implementation because the CNN evaluates all discriminant features. CNN was compared to other classifiers in a comprehensive analysis. Brown spot, grey spot, rust, and other leaf spots can be treated immediately with the proposed work.

articleTitle: Frequency Stabilty of Egyptian Power Grid with Unification of Renewable Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: This wrapping presents a segregated concept of load frequency control strategies in the Egyptian power grid with the puncture of inexhaustible energy sources. The basic model of the Egyptian power grid is broken up into three basic models: non-warm, warm, and hydroelectric power plants. Additional somatic curtailments, like generator rate curtailments and the governor fallen band, are taken in account in this instance. The controller design has been taken for each subsystem to evaluate the frequency stability of the whole system. A harmonic search algorithm has been applied to the accurate modelling of controller gain in a purposed power system, and it enhances the frequency steadiness of a particular Egyptian power system (EPS) model. A MATLAB simulation study has been carried out for a decentralized and centralized power system with different loading patterns. The purpose of the simulation study is to give a better dynamic response, which gives better frequency stability in terms of peak overreach and steady time.

articleTitle: Combining CNN and SVM for Robust Cattle Disease Classification in Veterinary Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Noteworthy problems in the cattle livestock sector stem from infectious diseases that impact the health of animals and the production output. Precise and prompt detection is essential for both treatment and prevention to be successful. This study presents a CNN-SVM model to enhance the exactness of categorizing cattle diseases. The dataset included 2,000 photographs put into five illness classifications (Healthy, Foot-and-Mouth illness, Mastitis, Bovine Respiratory Disease, and Lameness), with 80 % for training and 20% for evaluation. CNN turned to ImageNet, which turned out to be a feature extractor, and the SVM with a radial basis function (RBF) kernel categorized the identified features. Experimental results reveal that the hybrid model outperforms the independent CNN and SVM models. Ultimately, the success rate of the CNN-SVM model is 92.7 %, more successful than the CNN (88.4%) and SVM models (84.5%). Also, the hybrid model attained an average accuracy of 91.5 %, a recall of 90.8 %, and an F1 score of 91.1%, showing a balanced performance concerning all criteria. The figure of 0.93 for the Area Under the Curve (AUC) of the Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curve for all illness categories, on average, suggests the model has outstanding discriminative capabilities. The evidence reveals that the CNN-SVM hybrid model is a valid and valuable classification method for recognizing diseases in cattle, which stands out as an essential development from other techniques. Additional research is required to better the dataset and examine alternative model frameworks to elevate performance and relevance under actual circumstances.

articleTitle: Detecting Ship Wake from Complex Backgrounds in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) Imagery
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Ship wake identification is crucial for analyzing ocean surface synthetic aperture radar (SAR) pictures because ship wakes typically include important vessel information. A significant proportion of detection algorithms make use of the linear traits of ship wakes by converting the lines in the spatial domain into either dark or light points in a transform domain, using techniques like the Hough or Radon transforms. This study presents a novel approach for detecting ship wakes using a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM). The method involves obtaining the Radon transform of the SAR image, which enhances the visibility of linear features. In comparison to the state of art methodologies, the findings show that the method is successful in achieving greater wake detection accuracies.

articleTitle: Water Region Extraction in Aerial Images Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Water bodies are essential component of Earth’s surface and accurate water region mapping is crucial for disaster management and environmental monitoring. Existing methods to map water bodies relies on traditional modelling methods that need extensive manual calibration struggle with scalability and lack advanced pattern recognition. This paper evaluates the effectiveness of deep learning-based semantic segmentation models, DeepLabV3+ and U-Net, using aerial images resized to $\mathbf{2 5 6 x} 256$ pixels in mapping water regions in aerial images. DeepLabV3+, with a ResNet50 backbone, and U-Net are trained on a comprehensive flood-affected dataset with preprocessing techniques such as resizing and augmentation. Model performance is assessed using metrics like IoU, F1 score, accuracy, precision, and recall. The results indicate that DeepLabV3+ outperforms U-Net, showing promise for automating water region mapping and improving flood surveys and urban planning.

articleTitle: A Recommendation and Genre-Classification Model for Sound-Alikes
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Sound-alikes of a particular musical piece are songs or musical pieces that sound similar to it. Apart from the legal nature of a topic like this, there is a need among music listeners to recommend songs that match the tone of the one currently being listened to, genre-wise and based on how similar it sounds to the currently-played music. This research explores the idea of recommending five sound-alikes of an input song based on cosine similarity and genre classification upon the GTZAN dataset, such that the user can then pick and select what music they would prefer to listen to next. A variety of machine learning models have been studied for genre classification upon the said dataset, and a conclusion has been reached regarding which model performs the best.

articleTitle: Implementation and Performance Analysis of 8-bit Digital Parallel Array Multipliers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: This paper presents the implementation and performance analysis of five digital parallel array multipliers: Conventional Array Multiplier, Modified Braun’s Multiplier, Vedic Multiplier, Booth’s Multiplier, and Baugh-Wooley Multiplier. It details the design principles, algorithms, and hardware implementations of each multiplier. The multipliers are evaluated based on speed, area, and power consumption via simulation using Xilinx Vivado software with Artix-7 FPGA Board. The results highlight the trade-offs in each design and provide insights into their suitability for various digital signal processing applications.

articleTitle: A Novel Dolph-Chebyshev Filter for Prediction of Huntington’s Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Mutation in all the cases doesn’t specify cancer; rather a special type of mutation, where a trinucleotide repeat (cytosine-adenine-guanine (CAG)) in DNA exceeds the normal range, causes Huntington’s disease (HD); a mutational disorder. The present work specifies a non-invasive method of spectral estimation technique based on Trigonometric mapping. A Fourier Transform approach along with the Dolph-Chebyshev filter has been designed and applied to raw genomic data for predicting the disease. Moreover, the proposed algorithm has been tested for both healthy and HD benchmark datasets. Since a disease gene is more random compared to a healthy one, the variance is calculated. It is observed that in the case of all HD datasets, the value of $\operatorname{SNR}(\mu / \sigma)$ is less than 0.1, whereas, in the case of a healthy gene set, it is found to be more than 0.1. For all other parameters also the result is found to be satisfactory.

articleTitle: Real-Time Text Classification and Summarization Model by Enhancing TF-IDF Extractive Summarization Method
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: The rapid growth of textual data across various platforms necessitates efficient real-time text classification and summarization methods. This paper presents a novel approach for developing a real-time text classification and summarization model that addresses the limitations of traditional methods, such as TFIDF, in extractive summarization. The proposed algorithm implemented advanced preprocessing techniques and a similarity matrix for enhanced pattern recognition, which leads to more accurate and contextually relevant summaries. Additionally, the model has integrated logistic regression that ensures the precise topic identification.

articleTitle: QLSTM4FM: Quantum Assisted Long Short-Term Memory Framework for Financial Market Trend Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: This research explores a novel hybrid neural network architecture for stock price forecasting that integrates Variational Quantum Layers (VQLs) to enhance efficiency and trainability. It examines various quantum-classical algorithms through extensive simulations on both classical and quantum hardware, utilizing key stock indicators like MACD, EMA, Bollinger Bands, and momentum metrics, alongside sentiment analysis of financial news. The dataset used includes real-time stock prices for 15 companies, focusing on Merck & Co. (MRK). By framing stock price forecasting as a binary classification problem, It proposes QLSTM4FM i.e. a unique framework based on quantum-assisted LSTM model, which significantly enhances stock price forecasting. It conducts a thorough and comprehensive performance evaluation of the proposed framework against classical LSTM models. Results show that QLSTM4FM, featuring quantum-enhanced layers, outperforms classical LSTM models in accuracy, lower loss, and faster convergence, demonstrating the potential of quantum computing in financial forecasting.

articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Security: The Future of Credit Card Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: The study looks at the big issue of credit card theft, which has gotten worse because more people are shopping online, especially during the COVID-19 pandemic, when these thefts have increased a lot. The research uses methods like Logistic Regression, Decision Tree Classifier, and K-Nearest Neighbors. It analyzes data that includes changed numerical features from PCA analyses, as well as transaction time and amount. In fraud detection, the cross-validation score, ROC AUC score, and F1 score show how accurate these algorithms are. The cross-validation score for detecting fraud with a decision tree was 96.67% The ROC AUC score was 91.36%, and the F1 score was $\mathbf{9 0 \%}$. The K-Nearest Neighbors method worked really well for finding fraud. It had a ROC AUC score of $\mathbf{9 7}.63 \%$, a cross-validation score of $\mathbf{9 9.} 34 \%$, and an F1 score of 97%.

articleTitle: A New Variant of Clustering based Normalized Knn Movie Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: In recent years, Recommender Systems (RS) have experienced significant growth across various sectors. Because of the recent growth of many e-commerce companies and online video services like Netflix, YouTube, Hotstar, etc., researchers are quite interested in it. The goal of the collaborative filtering-based recommender system is to provide users with movie or video recommendations based on their past viewing preferences. A rating matrix is typically used to display this data. In this study, the K-nearest neighbor and hierarchical clustering techniques are used to create a movie recommendation system. This work develops recommender systems using a range of instruments and methods. Several techniques, such as clustering techniques, KNN, collaborative filtering, and content-based filtering, are described in depth. The suggested approach for developing the movie recommender system is then illustrated, showing how it would be implemented and operated. First, the proposed model checks similar movies in the movie list and uses a hierarchical clustering technique to make the cluster of similar movies. For this process, Jaccard distance is used. Then the proposed methodology uses the K-nearest neighbor algorithm to recommend the best suitable movies to the users. To verify the suggested method, this study uses the Movielens dataset, which is available on Kaggle. Python is used as the programming language for implementing the system.

articleTitle: Smart & Digital Power Station
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Industry 4.0 & a growing trend in the electric power utility industry is the automated monitoring of remote sites and assets.An electric utility’s assets must be maintained and repaired on a continuous basis to prevent equipment failures and outages and to keep the system operating safely. With the challenge of keeping costs under control and service reliability high, knowing how to prioritize maintenance and repairs in order to provide the most efficient and cost-effective results is a huge benefit. The development of both sensor technology and communications networks is now providing the means to deploy solutions that can track the health of assets and plan when maintenance should be scheduled to prevent failures. To prevent the utility from being overloaded with the enormous amount of data from the field, there are also applications available to view the data in real-time and process it in order to determine health scores and predict when and how failures might occur. Sensor technology can also allow the utility to perform remote inspections to make more efficient use of man and machine hours.

articleTitle: Utilization of Decentralized Finance (DeFi) and Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) in Banking operations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) is a decentralized database system where transactions are recorded and verified across multiple nodes. Its key features include immutability, time-stamping, and consensus-based validation. Numerous DLT applications are in supply chain management, intellectual property, cross border payments, energy trading, real estate, and online donations. DeFi, a combination of cryptocurrency and blockchain technology, offers financial services without intermediaries. Hence transactions with various digital assets based on cryptocurrency price feeds needs an automated framework. Smart contracts, self-executing contracts with terms directly written into code, automate processes and reduce manual intervention. This paper proposes a decentralized financial trading model using the AAVE protocol. AAVE is a decentralized platform that allows for transactions with various digital assets based on cryptocurrency price feeds. Proposed model uses Chainlink, a decentralized oracle network, to provide accurate and reliable price feeds. IPFS is used for data storage, while Graph is employed for indexing and querying blockchain data. The paper presents an example of a DeFi protocol to simulate banking operations, showcasing the potential of DeFi and DLT in revolutionizing traditional banking processes.

articleTitle: Refining Obesity Risk Models: Gradient Boosting for Superior Predictive Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: It is important to recognize the risk of obesity. In this study, we compared three machine learning models to see how well they can detect the risk of obesity. The best model was the XGBoost classifier, which was 91% accurate. The other two models, LightGBM and CatBoost, were a bit less accurate, each at $\mathbf{9 0 \%}$. These models could be important for identifying people at risk of obesity. They can help create personalized healthcare plans to prevent obesity and its serious related health issues. This helps them find small patterns that could show a risk of obesity. This information can help people create personalized ways to prevent and manage obesity. Finding the right people who are at risk of becoming overweight could be an important finding to improve public health. Person-time detection can help find people who are at risk so that we can focus on preventing problems.

articleTitle: Enhance the Intrusion Detection performance of WSN using RLA
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is a promising technology for numerous real-time applications because to the fact that it is cost-effective, is of a manageable size, and can be distributed. Nevertheless, sensor nodes are vulnerable to assaults, including illegal entrance, hacking, faulty hardware that generates a physical event, and other situations that are comparable to these. As a result, it is essential to mount a defense against an intrusion when a sensor node is involved. Reinforcement Learning (RL) is a branch of machine learning (ML) that uses many algorithms, each algorithm explains the data it uses in a different way. The RL algorithm is applied to increase the whole capability of connections when simultaneously assuring the reliability and minimizing the severe communications delay. RL algorithm is a lightweight learning method and it increasing the detection of intrusions by tracking the activity of sensor nodes in the WSN.

articleTitle: Cryptocurrency Price Prediction: A Comprehensive Analysis of High-dimensional Features with Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: The most well-known encrypted money, Bitcoin, has a lot of promise in the future. Investors and traders always try to find a technique to forecast cryptocurrency prices to lower their risks and boost profits. However, predicting the price of cryptocurrencies is a difficult undertaking because of their unpredictability, volatility, and mobility. Different prediction architectures have been developed by researchers using machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), and statistical methods. In this work, predictions are made utilizing the AutoRegressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBOOST), Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models. The historical bitcoin market data is chosen, it spans the months of January 2012 through September 2020. The LSTM model performs well when compared to other models, producing a minimal Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 5.836 and a minimal Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of 7.472. Increased return on investment can be achieved by investors by making well-informed decisions on what to buy, hold, or sell. That’s particularly the case with predictions about the price of Bitcoin.

articleTitle: Potato Plant Leaf Disease Detection using optimized CNN and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: The plant disease is a significant concern in the agriculture field. Many diseases destroy the crop badly. Optimized Convolutional neural network (CNN) model having seven convolutional layer with weight pruning is used for detecting disease on potato leaves. Further transfer learning is used to compare the results of the proposed model. Plant Village dataset which contains potato disease-Early blight and late blight is used. Both the diseases are fungaldiseases. Used transfer learning models are Resnet50, VGG16 and VGG19.

articleTitle: Exploring User Engagement with TikTok Live Shopping: A Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: The significance of sentiment analysis within text mining and natural language processing (NLP) has grown in response to the expanding accessibility of web-based applications and social media platforms for opinion dissemination. This research focuses on analyzing X (Twitter) platform data regarding user reactions to TikTok store closures in Indonesia to measure people’s interest and enthusiasm for TikTok Live Shopping. This research employs a deep learning algorithm from the RapidMiner framework to classify sentiment into positive, negative, and neutral categories. Originally known for short videos, TikTok has grown into a platform that combines entertainment and commerce through its Live Shopping. The aim of this research is to understand whether TikTok Live Shopping is an effective tool for brands to increase their presence in the market. The study concluded that although TikTok Live Shopping has potential, it is underutilized. Future research should extend the data collection period and diversify data sources to make the analysis more comprehensive. Additionally, using advanced sentiment classification methods and comparing TikTok Live Shopping with other platforms can provide deeper insights into user performance and engagement.

articleTitle: Intelligent Data Science-Driven Univariate Time Series Forecasting for Household Debris Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Sustainable Innovations in Technology (IC-SIT)
abstract: Green material reuse stands as a beacon of sustainability in our modern world. The whole world is facing challenges such as climate change, resource depletion, and waste management.
